Tokentrim 6.9% Output Shrink

You can use Tokentrim to shrink your tool output by 6.9%, which helps reduce costs and optimize your workflow. On this site, you can learn how to install and use Tokentrim to achieve this output shrink and explore its other features, such as summarizing earlier conversations and reading files in ranges.

How it Works for Output Shrink

Tokentrim is a local toolkit that trims tool output, among other features. To achieve the 6.9% output shrink, you simply need to install Tokentrim as a plugin or via git clone, and then use it to process your tool output. The output shrink is just one of the benefits of using Tokentrim, which also includes a dashboard and other tools to help you manage your workflow. You can also use the replay command to see your own numbers and understand how Tokentrim is helping you optimize your output.

What You Get and Costs

With Tokentrim, you get a range of features for free, including all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert. If you want additional features, such as a hosted dashboard on any device, Monday digest, and weekly budget with alert, you can upgrade to Pro for a lifetime fee of $49 or a monthly fee of $9. The Pro version also allows you to use up to 3 machines and receive Slack totals.

FAQ

What is the biggest saving I can get with Tokentrim? The biggest saving is from summarizing earlier conversations, which can cut history re-read by 75% and make limits last 4.0x longer, resulting in a billed cost fall of roughly 55-70%. Do I need to pay for Tokentrim to use its features? No, many features are free, including all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert. Is my data secure with Tokentrim? Yes, nothing leaves your machine by default, so you can be sure that your data is secure.
